operators.name: custom_softmax

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, channels, height, width]

semantics: Computes softmax along the specified dimension dim, matching torch.nn.functional.softmax.
Axis ordering and reduction follow the reference exactly; no normalization over other dimensions.
Stabilizes computation by subtracting the max along dim before exponentiation, consistent with PyTorch softmax.
Output has the same shape, dtype, device, and stride as the input, preserving semantics.
The dim parameter is an integer and must be within the tensor rank.

operators.name: custom_pixel_shuffle

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, C_in * r^2, height, width]

returns.shape: same as reference step: [batch, C_in, height * r, width * r]

semantics: Implements PixelShuffle with the given upscale_factor r, matching torch.nn.PixelShuffle.
Rearranges input of shape (N, C_in * r^2, H, W) to output (N, C_in, H * r, W * r).
The mapping is out[n, c_out, h_out, w_out] = in[n, c_out * r^2 + (h_out % r) * r + (w_out % r), h_out // r, w_out // r].
No interpolation or padding; purely a reshape-permute operation.
Preserves dtype and device; output stride may differ due to layout transformation.
Applies softmax over channel dimension (dim=1) for each spatial location and batch.
Input shape [512, 12, 128, 128] -> output shape [512, 12, 128, 128], dtype float32 on CUDA.
Numerically stable via max subtraction; no change to total sum along dim (excluding floating rounding).
PixelShuffle with upscale_factor=2 reshapes channels to spatial dimensions.
Input shape [512, 12, 128, 128] -> output shape [512, 3, 256, 256], dtype float32 on CUDA.
Returns the final output tensor of shape [512, 3, 256, 256].
Same object as step_002 output; no additional computation.
